Your offer letter has been saved to **`senior-software-engineer-offer-letter.md`**.

## What's Included

The letter follows the skill's best-practice template and is customized for a senior software engineer role, with:

- **Position Details** — Senior Software Engineer, Engineering department, full-time/exempt
- **Compensation** — Base salary, performance bonus eligibility, and equity/stock options
- **Benefits** — Health insurance, 401(k), PTO, holidays, plus a professional development stipend (common for engineering roles)
- **Contingencies** — Background check, right-to-work verification, and required agreements (Confidentiality + IP Assignment, which are critical for engineering positions)
- **At-Will Employment** — Clear language to avoid creating an implied employment contract
- **Acceptance Block** — Signature section with a deadline to keep the offer time-bound

## Placeholders to Fill In

Before sending, replace all bracketed items:
- `[Company Letterhead]`, `[DATE]`, `[COMPANY NAME]`, `[Candidate Name]` and address
- `[Engineering Manager Name/Title]` and `[Office Location / Remote]`
- `[Proposed Start Date]` and `[DEADLINE DATE]`
- `$[AMOUNT]` for salary and all benefit amounts (`[X]%`, `[X] days`, etc.)
- `[HR Contact]` and contact details
- Whether equity applies and the vesting terms

⚠️ **Important:** This is a template for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. Have qualified legal counsel review the final document, especially the equity, bonus, and non-compete provisions, since these vary by jurisdiction.
